_comment: Amazon links shown beside tracker items. Links only: the hourly checker never fetches Amazon. Each ASIN was opened on amazon.com and its title matched to the tracked product on the 'verified' date. build_site.py adds the Associates tag. Tracked products with no verified match fall back to their brand link. 'listings' maps a tracked store listing URL (for items without a canonical product id) to its verified Amazon ASIN.
